result:
Confirmed clean: scratch file removed, full suite (73 files / 616 tests) still passes, and typecheck/lint are clean.

Summary of fixes applied across 8 files:
- `src/lib/mentions.ts` — `resolveMentions` now maps each handle to *all* members sharing it (was last-write-wins) and no longer excludes viewer-role members from being mentioned.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` — mention resolution now pages through *every* active member instead of capping at 100 (fixing lookups for longest-standing members in larger workspaces); the comment's own author is excluded from recorded mentions; the edit window is measured from `createdAt` instead of `updatedAt`; `updateComment` now re-resolves mentions from the new body, persists them, and emits `comment.updated` with only the newly-mentioned users; `createComment` passes `parentId` through and scopes its rate-limit consumption by `actor.userId`.
- `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts` — `updateComment` now persists the resolved `mentionedUserIds`; `listThread` was rewritten to flatten replies of replies (any depth) under their top-level ancestor in posting order, and to keep deleted comments as textless placeholders instead of dropping them (and their replies).
- `src/types/event.ts` — added `comment.updated` event and an optional `parentId` on `comment.created`.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts` — `comment.created` now also notifies the parent comment's author on a reply, and excludes mentioned users from the plain "new comment" alert so a mention alert always takes precedence (no more double alerts); added a `comment.updated` subscriber that notifies newly-mentioned users.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` — added a `comment.updated` listener so edited comment text is reindexed for search.
- `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` — `consumeRateLimit` accepts an optional `scope` that further partitions the token bucket (used for per-member keying) without changing capacity derivation.
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts` and the service's own call — both now scope the comment-posting rate limit by `actor.userId`, so one member's burst no longer throttles the rest of the workspace.
- `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx` — stopped filtering out archived (deleted) nodes/replies so deleted-comment placeholders actually render and keep their replies anchored.
